\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{جرم} (jorm)}{جرم (jorm)}]{\fa{جرم} (jorm) — a crime}

\label{lesson:FA-C407-jorm}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a verdict, then the Persian for a trial.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{جرم}}
\textbf{\fa{جرم}} (\emph{jorm}) — \textquotedblleft{}a crime\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{دزدی} \fa{یک} \fa{جرم} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{dozdi yek jorm ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Theft is a crime.
\end{quote}

Plural \emph{jarâyem}, an Arabic broken plural. More serious than \emph{takhallof}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{جرم}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{jurm} \textquotedblleft{}offence, crime\textquotedblright{}, from the same Arabic family as \emph{jarime} \textquotedblleft{}a fine\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jorm}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jorm}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{jorm}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a verdict, then the Persian for a trial, then say \emph{jorm} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{جرم} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A crime\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{مجرم} (mojrem)}{مجرم (mojrem)}]{\fa{مجرم} (mojrem) — a criminal, an offender}

\label{lesson:FA-C407-mojrem}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a trial, then the Persian for a crime.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{مجرم}}
\textbf{\fa{مجرم}} (\emph{mojrem}) — \textquotedblleft{}a criminal, an offender\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{پلیس} \fa{مجرم} \fa{را} \fa{پیدا} \fa{کرد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{polis mojrem râ peydâ kard.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The police found the criminal.
\end{quote}

Plural \emph{mojremân}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{مجرم}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{mujrim} \textquotedblleft{}offender\textquotedblright{}, one who has committed a \emph{jurm}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mojrem}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mojrem}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{mojrem}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a trial, then the Persian for a crime, then say \emph{mojrem} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{مجرم} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A criminal, an offender\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{دستگیر} \fa{کردن} (dastgir kardan)}{دستگیر کردن (dastgir kardan)}]{\fa{دستگیر} \fa{کردن} (dastgir kardan) — to arrest}

\label{lesson:FA-C407-dastgir-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a crime, then the Persian for a criminal.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{دستگیر} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{دستگیر} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{dastgir kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to arrest\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{پلیس} \fa{دزد} \fa{را} \fa{در} \fa{خیابان} \fa{دستگیر} \fa{کرد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{polis dozd râ dar khiyâbân dastgir kard.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The police arrested the thief in the street.
\end{quote}

\emph{Dast} \textquotedblleft{}hand\textquotedblright{} + \emph{gir} \textquotedblleft{}taking\textquotedblright{} + \emph{kardan}. \emph{Dastgir shodan} — to be arrested.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{دستگیر} \fa{کردن}} is native Persian, built from \emph{dast} \textquotedblleft{}hand\textquotedblright{} + \emph{gir-}, the present stem of \emph{gereftan} \textquotedblleft{}to take\textquotedblright{}, + \emph{kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}. To arrest is to take someone by the hand.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dastgir kardan}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dastgir kardan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{dastgir kardan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a crime, then the Persian for a criminal, then say \emph{dastgir kardan} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{دستگیر} \fa{کردن} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To arrest\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{بی} \fa{گناه} (bigonâh)}{بی گناه (bigonâh)}]{\fa{بی} \fa{گناه} (bigonâh) — innocent}

\label{lesson:FA-C407-bigonah}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a criminal, then the Persian for to arrest.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{بی} \fa{گناه}}
\textbf{\fa{بی} \fa{گناه}} (\emph{bigonâh}) — \textquotedblleft{}innocent\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{قاضی} \fa{گفت} \fa{که} \fa{او} \fa{بی} \fa{گناه} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{qâzi goft ke u bigonâh ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The judge said that he was innocent.
\end{quote}

\emph{Bi-} \textquotedblleft{}without\textquotedblright{} + \emph{gonâh} \textquotedblleft{}guilt\textquotedblright{}. The opposite is \emph{gonâhkâr}, guilty.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{بی} \fa{گناه}} is native Persian, built from \emph{bi-} \textquotedblleft{}without\textquotedblright{} + \emph{gonâh} \textquotedblleft{}sin, guilt\textquotedblright{}, usually traced to Middle Persian \emph{wināh}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bigonâh}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bigonâh}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{bigonâh}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a criminal, then the Persian for to arrest, then say \emph{bigonâh} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{بی} \fa{گناه} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Innocent\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{محکوم} \fa{کردن} (mahkum kardan)}{محکوم کردن (mahkum kardan)}]{\fa{محکوم} \fa{کردن} (mahkum kardan) — to sentence; to condemn}

\label{lesson:FA-C407-mahkum-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to arrest, then the Persian for innocent.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{محکوم} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{محکوم} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{mahkum kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to sentence; to condemn\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{قاضی} \fa{او} \fa{را} \fa{به} \fa{یک} \fa{سال} \fa{زندان} \fa{محکوم} \fa{کرد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{qâzi u râ be yek sâl zendân mahkum kard.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The judge sentenced him to a year in prison.
\end{quote}

\emph{Be chizi mahkum kardan} — to sentence to something. Also to condemn in public.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{محکوم}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{maḥkūm} \textquotedblleft{}judged, sentenced\textquotedblright{}, from the same Arabic family as \emph{ḥukm} \textquotedblleft{}judgement\textquotedblright{}; \emph{kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{} is inherited Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mahkum kardan}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mahkum kardan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{mahkum kardan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to arrest, then the Persian for innocent, then say \emph{mahkum kardan} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 400–407 — a review}

\label{lesson:FA-R407-review-400-407}



\begin{quote}
Say the Persian for a faculty and tuition fees.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a faculty, tuition fees, to be admitted, a scholarship, a course credit
  \item to revise, to concentrate, to cheat, lecture notes, homework
  \item research, scholarly research, an article, a thesis, a lecture
  \item a graduate, education, to present, a bachelor's degree, a doctorate
  \item regulations, forbidden, allowed, to observe, to break
  \item legal, illegal, an offence, a punishment, a permit
  \item a judge, accused, a witness, a verdict, a trial
  \item a crime, a criminal, to arrest, innocent, to sentence
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A faculty? (\textbf{\fa{دانشکده}}.) Tuition fees? (\textbf{\fa{شهریه}}.) To be admitted? (\textbf{\fa{پذیرفته} \fa{شدن}}.) A scholarship? (\textbf{\fa{بورسیه}}.) A course credit? (\textbf{\fa{واحد}}.) To revise? (\textbf{\fa{مرور} \fa{کردن}}.) To concentrate? (\textbf{\fa{تمرکز} \fa{کردن}}.) To cheat? (\textbf{\fa{تقلب} \fa{کردن}}.) Lecture notes? (\textbf{\fa{جزوه}}.) Homework? (\textbf{\fa{تکلیف}}.) Research? (\textbf{\fa{تحقیق}}.) Scholarly research? (\textbf{\fa{پژوهش}}.) An article? (\textbf{\fa{مقاله}}.) A thesis? (\textbf{\fa{پایان} \fa{نامه}}.) A lecture? (\textbf{\fa{سخنرانی}}.) A graduate? (\textbf{\fa{فارغ} \fa{التحصیل}}.) Education? (\textbf{\fa{تحصیلات}}.) To present? (\textbf{\fa{ارائه} \fa{دادن}}.) A bachelor's degree? (\textbf{\fa{لیسانس}}.) A doctorate? (\textbf{\fa{دکترا}}.) Regulations? (\textbf{\fa{مقررات}}.) Forbidden? (\textbf{\fa{ممنوع}}.) Allowed? (\textbf{\fa{مجاز}}.) To observe? (\textbf{\fa{رعایت} \fa{کردن}}.) To break? (\textbf{\fa{نقض} \fa{کردن}}.) Legal? (\textbf{\fa{قانونی}}.) Illegal? (\textbf{\fa{غیرقانونی}}.) An offence? (\textbf{\fa{تخلف}}.) A punishment? (\textbf{\fa{مجازات}}.) A permit? (\textbf{\fa{مجوز}}.) A judge? (\textbf{\fa{قاضی}}.) Accused? (\textbf{\fa{متهم}}.) A witness? (\textbf{\fa{شاهد}}.) A verdict? (\textbf{\fa{حکم}}.) A trial? (\textbf{\fa{محاکمه}}.) A crime? (\textbf{\fa{جرم}}.) A criminal? (\textbf{\fa{مجرم}}.) To arrest? (\textbf{\fa{دستگیر} \fa{کردن}}.) Innocent? (\textbf{\fa{بی} \fa{گناه}}.) To sentence? (\textbf{\fa{محکوم} \fa{کردن}}.)
